name: Telegram Class Booking Bot for Fitness Studios

parameters.content:
## 🏋️ TELEGRAM CLASS BOOKING BOT FOR FITNESS STUDIOS
**What it does:** FLOW A — a Telegram message arrives → staff role check → AI classifies the booking intent (view_schedule / book / reschedule / cancel / other) → class timetable + double-booking guard (room AND trainer) in Google Sheets → Telegram reply, every step logged. Admins manage classes with /addclass and /cancelclass. FLOW B — every morning at 8 AM, members with a class in the next 24h get a Telegram reminder → sheet flips to `REMINDER_SENT` → admin digest.

**You'll need:**
- Telegram bot token (@BotFather → /newbot) + your admin chat ID
- OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com)
- Google Sheets OAuth2 credentials

**Status flow (Bookings tab):** `RECEIVED` → `CONFIRMED` / `PENDING_SLOT` / `CANCELLED` / `RESCHEDULED` / `REMINDER_SENT` / `HANDLED`
**Sheets tabs:** `Classes` (weekly timetable) · `Bookings` (ledger) · `Staff` (admin/trainer roles)

## STEP 1 — Telegram trigger + CONFIG + role check + AI intent
Telegram message → CONFIG — Studio → log a row with status `RECEIVED` → look the sender up in the Staff tab → staff go to the admin branch (STEP 4), everyone else goes to the AI Agent, which classifies intent and extracts class/date/time/room via a Structured Output Parser.

## STEP 2 — Switch routes by intent
view_schedule → read the Classes timetable → Telegram reply with upcoming classes + free spots. book / reschedule → slot check (STEP 3). cancel → find the member's booking → mark CANCELLED. other → friendly fallback reply listing the commands.

## STEP 3 — Double-booking guard + confirm
book/reschedule → read Classes + Bookings → Code checks for an overlapping CONFIRMED booking on the same date + time using the SAME room or the SAME trainer, and enforces capacity (Booked < Capacity). Free → append booking (`CONFIRMED` / `RESCHEDULED`) → Telegram confirmation. Busy/full → suggest 3 alternative slots → sheet `PENDING_SLOT`.

## STEP 4 — Admin branch (staff only)
`/addclass Class | Day | Time | Room | Trainer | Capacity` appends a row to Classes. `/cancelclass Class | Day | Time` marks that class CANCELLED. Anything else gets the admin help reply. Only Telegram user IDs listed in the Staff tab reach this branch.

## STEP 5 — Daily 8 AM reminder sweep
Schedule trigger → read Bookings → keep CONFIRMED bookings in the next 24h with an empty Reminder Sent → Telegram reminder per member → sheet `REMINDER_SENT` + Reminder Sent = YES → Telegram digest to the admin chat ID.

## STEP 6 — Sheets logging + Telegram digest
Every booking branch merges → one booking summary is built → Telegram digest to the admin chat ID (CONFIG — Notifications). The reminder sweep builds its own digest.

options.systemMessage:
=You are the friendly booking assistant for {{ $('CONFIG — Studio').first().json.studio_name }}, a fitness studio. A member just wrote on Telegram. Extract their class-booking intent precisely:
- 'view_schedule' = they want to see class schedules / available slots / timings
- 'book' = they want to BOOK a class (with or without a date/time)
- 'reschedule' = they want to MOVE an existing booking to another day/time
- 'cancel' = they want to CANCEL an existing booking
- 'other' = anything else (prices, greetings, questions, membership)

Today is {{ $now.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd') }} and the studio timezone is {{ $('CONFIG — Studio').first().json.timezone }}. Convert any mentioned date/time into YYYY-MM-DD and 24-hour HH:MM in that timezone (assume upcoming dates when ambiguous; 'tomorrow' means the next calendar day). Leave fields empty when not mentioned. Output ONLY via the structured output parser.

parameters.inputSchema:
{
  "intent": "one of: view_schedule | book | reschedule | cancel | other",
  "class_name": "class name, or empty string if not given",
  "date": "YYYY-MM-DD date of the class, or empty string if no date mentioned",
  "time": "HH:MM 24-hour time, or empty string if no time mentioned",
  "room": "room name if mentioned, or empty string",
  "customer_name": "member's name, or empty string if not given",
  "phone": "phone number if given, or empty string",
  "notes": "any other relevant detail from the message, or empty string"
}

I can help you:

• BOOK — book a class (e.g. “Book Morning Yoga tomorrow 7am”)
